name: SOC 2 — Trust Services Criteria
description: Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality and Privacy. The Common Criteria (Security) are always in scope; the other four categories are selected per engagement. Criterion descriptions here are paraphrased — see NOTICE.md.

requirements.title: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
requirements.text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values. (COSO Principle 1)

requirements.title: Board independence and oversight
requirements.text: The board of directors operates independently of management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control. (COSO Principle 2)

requirements.title: Structures, reporting lines and authority
requirements.text: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in pursuit of the entity's objectives. (COSO Principle 3)

requirements.title: Commitment to competence
requirements.text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop and retain competent individuals in alignment with its objectives. (COSO Principle 4)

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.text: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in pursuit of its objectives. (COSO Principle 5)

requirements.title: Relevant, quality information
requirements.text: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control. (COSO Principle 13)

requirements.title: Internal communication
requirements.text: The entity internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support its functioning. (COSO Principle 14)

requirements.title: External communication
requirements.text: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control. (COSO Principle 15)

requirements.title: Suitable objectives
requirements.text: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to them. (COSO Principle 6)

requirements.title: Risk identification and analysis
requirements.text: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives, and analyses those risks as a basis for determining how they should be managed. (COSO Principle 7)

requirements.title: Fraud risk
requirements.text: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives. (COSO Principle 8)

requirements.title: Significant change
requirements.text: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly affect the system of internal control. (COSO Principle 9)

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.text: The entity selects, develops and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning. (COSO Principle 16)

requirements.title: Evaluating and communicating deficiencies
requirements.text: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those responsible for corrective action, including senior management and the board where appropriate. (COSO Principle 17)

requirements.title: Selection and development of control activities
requirements.text: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels. (COSO Principle 10)

requirements.title: General controls over technology
requirements.text: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives. (COSO Principle 11)

requirements.title: Deployment through policies and procedures
requirements.text: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put those policies into action. (COSO Principle 12)

requirements.title: Logical access security
requirements.text: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.

requirements.title: User registration and authorisation
requirements.text: Prior to issuing system credentials, the entity registers and authorises new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity; credentials are removed when access is no longer required.

requirements.title: Least privilege and segregation of duties
requirements.text: The entity authorises, modifies or removes access to data, software, functions and other protected assets based on roles, responsibilities, least privilege and segregation of duties.

requirements.title: Physical access
requirements.text: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets to authorised personnel.

requirements.title: Decommissioning and data disposal
requirements.text: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been removed.

requirements.title: Boundary protection
requirements.text: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.

requirements.title: Restricted transmission and movement of data
requirements.text: The entity restricts the transmission, movement and removal of information to authorised internal and external users and processes, and protects it during transmission, movement or removal.

requirements.title: Malicious software prevention and detection
requirements.text: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorised or malicious software.

requirements.title: Configuration and vulnerability detection
requirements.text: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that introduce new vulnerabilities, and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.text: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters and errors affecting its ability to meet its objectives, and analyses them to determine whether they represent security events.

requirements.title: Security event evaluation
requirements.text: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure to meet its objectives, and if so takes action to prevent or address such failures.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.text: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response programme to understand, contain, remediate and communicate them as appropriate.

requirements.title: Recovery from incidents
requirements.text: The entity identifies, develops and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.text: The entity authorises, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures to meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Business disruption risk mitigation
requirements.text: The entity identifies, selects and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.

requirements.title: Vendor and business partner risk
requirements.text: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.text: The entity maintains, monitors and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and enable the implementation of additional capacity to help meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Environmental protections, backup and recovery
requirements.text: The entity authorises, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes and recovery infrastructure to meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Recovery testing
requirements.text: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Identification of confidential information
requirements.text: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet its objectives related to confidentiality.

requirements.title: Disposal of confidential information
requirements.text: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet its objectives related to confidentiality.

requirements.title: Processing objectives and data definitions
requirements.text: The entity obtains or generates, uses and communicates relevant, quality information regarding the definitions of processed data and product and service specifications to support the use of products and services.

requirements.title: Complete and accurate inputs
requirements.text: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy, to result in products, services and reporting that meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Processing
requirements.text: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services and reporting that meet its objectives.

requirements.title: Outputs
requirements.text: The entity implements policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately and timely in accordance with specifications.

requirements.title: Storage of inputs and outputs
requirements.text: The entity implements policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing and outputs completely, accurately and timely in accordance with system specifications.

requirements.title: Privacy notice
requirements.text: The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices to meet its objectives related to privacy, with notice updated and communicated in a timely manner.

requirements.title: Choice and consent
requirements.text: The entity communicates choices available regarding the collection, use, retention, disclosure and disposal of personal information, and obtains and documents consent where required.

requirements.title: Collection consistent with objectives
requirements.text: Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Explicit consent for sensitive information
requirements.text: For information requiring explicit consent, the entity communicates the need for such consent, obtains it prior to collection, and documents that consent.

requirements.title: Use limitation
requirements.text: The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in its objectives and consistent with consent received.

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.text: The entity retains personal information consistent with its objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Disposal
requirements.text: The entity securely disposes of personal information to meet its objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Subject access
requirements.text: The entity grants identified and authenticated data subjects the ability to access their stored personal information for review and, upon request, provides them with physical or electronic copies.

requirements.title: Correction
requirements.text: The entity corrects, amends or appends personal information on the basis of information provided by data subjects, and communicates such information to third parties as committed or required.

requirements.title: Disclosure with consent
requirements.text: The entity discloses personal information to third parties only with the explicit consent of data subjects, and such consent is obtained prior to disclosure.

requirements.title: Record of authorised disclosures
requirements.text: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate and timely record of authorised disclosures of personal information.

requirements.title: Record of unauthorised disclosures
requirements.text: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate and timely record of detected or reported unauthorised disclosures of personal information.

requirements.title: Third-party safeguards
requirements.text: The entity obtains privacy commitments from vendors and other third parties who have access to personal information, to enable it to meet its objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Third-party breach notification
requirements.text: The entity obtains commitments from vendors and other third parties with access to personal information to notify it in the event of actual or suspected unauthorised disclosure, and such notifications are assessed and addressed.

requirements.title: Breach notification to subjects
requirements.text: The entity provides notification of breaches and incidents to affected data subjects, regulators and others to meet its objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Accounting of disclosures
requirements.text: The entity provides data subjects with an accounting of the personal information held and, upon request, an accounting of disclosures of their information.

requirements.title: Accuracy and completeness
requirements.text: The entity collects and maintains accurate, up-to-date, complete and relevant personal information to meet its objectives related to privacy.

requirements.title: Complaint handling and enforcement
requirements.text: The entity implements a process for receiving, addressing, resolving and communicating the resolution of inquiries, complaints and disputes from data subjects and others, and periodically monitors compliance to meet its objectives related to privacy.
